periods.training: 2019-01-01/2021-01-01 measured local pressure; fit median ERA5 residual offset for comparison only
periods.model_selection: 2021 missing exact UTC hours; regional transfer scored reciprocal leave-one-station-out

limitations: ERA5 is a gridded reanalysis with assimilated observations, not an independent point sensor.
ERA5 hourly values are never interpolated or presented as 5-minute observations.
ERA5-Land hourly surface-pressure series could not be retrieved from the public API; CDS ARCO requires a CDS token.
Model-height transport uses dry-air hypsometric relation and ERA5 2m temperature proxy.
All created candidate values are separate ESTIMATED/UNAPPROVED rows.
